model_map.description: Claude-to-Codex alias mapping; defaults map fable, opus, sonnet and haiku to astra, sol, terra and luna.

default_effort.description: Effort per Claude alias when absent; defaults to high for fable and opus, medium for sonnet, low for haiku.

effort_map.description: Effort translation between agents; defaults preserve levels except ultra becomes max.

codex_name.description: Agent naming strategy, keep or underscore; defaults to keep.

drop_keys.description: Agent frontmatter keys explicitly discarded; defaults to color.

overrides.description: Per-agent model and effort overrides; defaults to an empty map.

match.description: Text in a peer question to match, in list order.

answer.description: Option label to select; trust and persistent approval grants are refused.

max_age_seconds.description: Oldest quota read, in seconds, that a verdict or an admission trusts; an older one is read again or counts as paid. Defaults to 120.

min_interval_share.description: Share of a window an interval must move before it measures a rate, above 0 and at most 1; a tier needs 3 such intervals. Defaults to 0.05.

margin.description: How far past a tier cut a rate must be before the tier steps up, and how far a new rate may drift before older rates are dropped, 0 or more and below 1; a step down applies at once. Defaults to 0.2.

max_weekly_share.description: Most of each agent's weekly window the whole calibration may spend, above 0 and at most 1; defaults to 0.10.

max_window_share.description: Most of a five-hour window calibration may spend before it pauses until the window resets, above 0 and at most 0.5; defaults to 0.5.

cell_max_minutes.description: Time cap for one cell in minutes; a task estimated above it is excluded. Defaults to 45.

cell_max_tokens.description: Token cap for one cell; a task estimated above it is excluded. Defaults to 1500000.

cell_max_turns.description: Turn cap for one cell; defaults to 100.

history_days.description: Days of history mined first, widened when a class has fewer than 3 tasks; defaults to 90.

filter.description: Size limits for commits mined as tasks, after dropping generated and vendored files.

min_files.description: Fewest changed files for a task; defaults to 1.

max_files.description: Most changed files for a task; defaults to 20.

min_lines.description: Fewest changed lines for a task; defaults to 10.

max_lines.description: Most changed lines for a task; defaults to 400.

large_max_files.description: Most changed files for the larger stratum, used only when the project's work is large; defaults to 40.

large_max_lines.description: Most changed lines for the larger stratum, used only when the project's work is large; defaults to 1500.

on_missing.description: Fallback for each missing capability kind; defaults to read_source for skills and lead_first for tools.

hints.description: One-line guidance keyed by capability name; defaults to an empty map.

on_auth_failure.description: What happens when a worker cannot sign in to its agent or to an MCP server; defaults to login_then_lead, which runs the agent's login once and hands the task to the lead when that fails.

login_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for a login the person must finish; defaults to 180.

mcp_tools.description: Tools a bridged MCP server offers the worker, keyed by server name; a server not listed is bridged whole. Defaults to an empty map.

description.description: What kind of work the class covers; shown to the lead when it classifies a task.

priority.description: quality picks the best entry unless a cheaper one is close; cost picks the cheapest good enough entry.

roles.description: Roles whose work this class routes.

ladder.description: Targets in configured order, cheapest first unless priors say otherwise.

steps.description: Ladders for single roles of the class, which override ladder for that role.

rubric.description: Questions the judge scores a run against.

checks.description: Commands or checks that count toward the score.

when.description: Feature names and the values they must have; every pair must match.

class.description: Class chosen when every pair in when matches.

enabled.description: Record worker changes and offer commit co-author lines; defaults to true.

claude.description: Claude co-author template with {name} and {model}; defaults to a display name and noreply@anthropic.com.

codex.description: Codex co-author template with {name} and {model}; defaults to OpenAI Codex, the model and noreply@openai.com.

skill_tests.description: Cross-model skill testing preference: ask before each change, always test, or never test; defaults to ask.

coauthors.description: Commit co-author templates for workers; enabled by default.

wire.description: Task and message encoding and size limits; defaults suit the file bus.

limits.description: Worker and session limits: resumable sessions per lead, live sessions per account by measured tier and in all, and the slot wait.

models.description: Model aliases and their prices, which drive estimates and admission of paid runs; defaults include the eight vendor families.

roles.description: Named task routes; overrides merge by role and field into the eleven defaults.

sessions.description: Thread lifetime limits; defaults close large or idle threads.

policy.description: Permission rules constrained by the lead; defaults ask for unmatched actions.

capabilities.description: Missing capability handling; defaults read skills and let the lead handle tools.

sync.description: Settings for generating agent and skill files; automatic sync defaults to true.

env_passthrough.description: Environment variables passed to workers; defaults include native OS login and agent config directories, not API keys. A free run drops names that bill per token even when listed; only paid_runs.<agent>.allow lets them through.

rex.description: Terminal capture and startup settings; defaults to 20 lines and 120 seconds.

learning.description: Learning mode: task classes, classification rules, ladders and priors; off by default.

telemetry.description: Local telemetry that never leaves the machine; on by default. User level, except that a project may turn off its own events.

calibration.description: Project calibration caps and task filters; calibration runs only when the person asks the lead for it.

paid_runs.description: Paid runs per agent with a daily USD cap, and the share of each window used on workspace accounts; paid runs are off by default.

balance.description: How quota reads and learned window rates are trusted: read age, interval size and the margin of a tier step up. The shared project config may only make these stricter.

routing.description: How a new task picks between a role's agents beyond the ladder: balance subscriptions by pace, and the margin. The shared project config may only tighten these.

model.description: Model alias from models, or a deliberate gpt- or claude- version pin.

prior.description: Guessed quality from 0 to 3, worth prior_runs judged runs.

enabled.description: Turns learning mode on; defaults to false, and with it off nothing changes.

threshold.description: Cost-first classes pick the cheapest entry whose quality minus the margin reaches this, 0 to 3; defaults to 2.5.

quality_margin.description: Quality-first classes pick a cheaper entry within this distance of the best one; defaults to 0.25.

prior_runs.description: How many judged runs a prior quality is worth; defaults to 2.

uncertainty.description: The margin is this divided by the square root of prior runs plus judged weight; defaults to 0.5.

profile_below_runs.description: Task finish offers to profile an entry with less judged weight than this; defaults to 3.

judges.description: Judge targets in order; the first whose agent neither side used judges; replaced as a whole by a layer.

classify.description: Ordered rules that map task features to a class; the first match wins and a layer replaces the list as a whole.

classes.description: Task classes; overrides merge by class and field into the ten defaults, and a new name adds a class.

manual_only_models.description: Model aliases requiring explicit manual permission; defaults to fable and astra.

max_live_sessions.description: Maximum live resumable sessions per lead and agent; defaults to 1 and excludes fresh runs. The account session limits apply too, and the lower one wins.

self_max_read_files.description: Maximum files for work handled by the lead on a provider limit; defaults to 3.

self_max_read_lines.description: Maximum lines for work handled by the lead on a provider limit; defaults to 200.

max_total_sessions.description: Most live sessions of all agents together: running workers and open peer panes of every lead and project; defaults to 10. The shared project config may only lower it.

sessions_by_tier.description: Most live sessions per agent by its measured subscription tier; defaults to 3, 5 and 10. A value above its default is capped at the default.

session_wait_seconds.description: Seconds a delegation waits for a free session slot, first come first served; defaults to 60. The shared project config may only lower it.

skill.description: Handling for a missing skill; defaults to read_source to read its SKILL.md.

mcp.description: Handling for a missing MCP server; defaults to lead_first. bridge hands the lead's server, with its credentials, to the worker for one run.

plugin.description: Handling for a missing plugin; defaults to lead_first.

agent.description: Vendor agent for this alias; defaults to claude or codex according to the family.

family.description: Codex model family used to resolve the newest visible version; absent for Claude aliases.

priced_for.description: Version whose prices are recorded; the prices drive estimates and admission of paid runs against the daily cap.

input.description: Input price in USD per million tokens; defaults to the recorded vendor price.

cached.description: Cached input price in USD per million tokens; defaults to the recorded vendor price.

output.description: Output price in USD per million tokens; defaults to the recorded vendor price.

note.description: Optional price caveat shown with estimates; empty unless the vendor has a special rate.

daily_cap_usd.description: Allowed paid runs need a daily cap above 0.

allow.description: Allow paid runs for this agent's workers and peers once the subscription cannot serve them; defaults to false. Needs daily_cap_usd above 0.

daily_cap_usd.description: Most USD paid runs of this agent may spend in the last 24 hours; defaults to 0 and must be above 0 with allow.

calibrate.description: Allow calibration on a paid route; defaults to false and needs allow.

env.description: Variables passed to this agent's processes only when paid runs are allowed; defaults to the agent's API key.

account.description: Account kind: workspace uses usable_share of each window; auto and personal use whole windows only while the quota read and the runs show no workspace evidence, which always wins; defaults to auto.

daily_cap_usd.description: Allowed paid runs need a daily cap above 0.

allow.description: Allow paid runs for this agent's workers and peers once the subscription cannot serve them; defaults to false. Needs daily_cap_usd above 0.

daily_cap_usd.description: Most USD paid runs of this agent may spend in the last 24 hours; defaults to 0 and must be above 0 with allow.

calibrate.description: Allow calibration on a paid route; defaults to false and needs allow.

env.description: Variables passed to this agent's processes only when paid runs are allowed; defaults to the agent's API key.

account.description: Account kind: workspace uses usable_share of each window; auto and personal use whole windows only while the quota read and the runs show no workspace evidence, which always wins; defaults to auto.

subscription_endpoints.description: Named base URLs that count as the subscription, such as a gateway in front of the claude.ai login; defaults to an empty map.

usable_share.description: Share of each window duolog uses on a workspace account, above 0 and at most 1; defaults to 0.5.

claude.description: Paid runs of Claude workers and peers; off by default.

codex.description: Paid runs of Codex workers and peers; off by default.

on_unmatched.description: Decision for an action with no matching rule; defaults to ask.

ask_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for a permission answer; defaults to 120.

rules.description: Permission rules for actions and paths; defaults allow routine work and deny sensitive operations.

stuck_notify_minutes.description: Minutes an unanswered peer question waits before one notification from peer wait; defaults to 5. Zero disables reminders.

auto_answers.description: Ordered question and option rules; replaces defaults, and an empty list disables them. Defaults to continuing without trusting Codex hooks.

capture_lines.description: Terminal lines captured to inspect state; defaults to 20. Answers are read from files.

start_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for terminal startup; defaults to 120.

use.description: Preferred agent, model and effort; defaults depend on the role.

fallback.description: Alternative target when the preferred agent is unavailable; defaults use the other vendor.

sandbox.description: Maximum file access for the role; defaults to read-only for reviews and workspace-write for edits.

context.description: Project instruction scope; defaults to project for code work and minimal for small tasks.

session.description: Thread reuse policy; defaults to fresh except plan, debug and debug_hard, which resume.

balance.description: Balance subscriptions by pace: pace starts a new task on the role's fallback while its use agent runs ahead of its weekly window, off keeps the ladder as written; defaults to pace. The shared project config may not turn it off.

margin.description: How far the used share of the weekly window may exceed the elapsed share before an agent counts as ahead of pace, and how far below pace it must fall to count as back, 0 or more and below 1; defaults to 0.10. The shared project config may only lower it.

action.description: Action type matched by this rule, such as read, write, exec, net or mcp (match server/tool).

match.description: Glob expression selecting paths or commands; ** matches all paths.

decision.description: Permission result for a matching rule; deny takes precedence over allow.

roles.description: Roles to which the rule applies; an omitted list applies to every role.

small.description: Live sessions of an agent at the small tier: unmeasured, paid, workspace or a window like a personal plan of about 20 USD a month; defaults to 3.

medium.description: Live sessions of an agent whose measured window is about 5 times the small one; defaults to 5.

large.description: Live sessions of an agent whose measured window is about 20 times the small one; defaults to 10.

resume_max_input_tokens.description: Cumulative input tokens before starting a new thread; defaults to 150000.

idle_close_minutes.description: Minutes of inactivity before closing a thread; defaults to 30.

drop_keys.description: Skill frontmatter keys explicitly discarded; defaults to an empty list.

auto.description: Update generated files from hooks after choosing a direction; defaults to true.

agents.description: Model, effort and frontmatter translation for agent files; defaults map vendor families.

skills.description: Frontmatter translation for skill files; defaults preserve all keys.

agent.description: Agent that runs this target; the default depends on the role.

model.description: Model alias from models, or a deliberate gpt- or claude- version pin; defaults by role.

effort.description: Requested reasoning effort; defaults by role and is capped by the lead when routed.

enabled.description: Keep local telemetry on this machine; defaults to true. User level; a project may set false to stop its own run, gate and peer events, and DUOLOG_TELEMETRY=off turns it off everywhere.

retention_days.description: Days a telemetry record lives, 1 to 30; defaults to 30. User level only; project layers cannot change it.

prune_every_hours.description: Hours between prunes triggered by a telemetry write; defaults to 6. User level only.

max_megabytes.description: Size cap of the whole telemetry store in megabytes, oldest segments removed first; defaults to 16. User level only.

max_summary_bytes.description: Maximum summary size in bytes; defaults to 200.

max_line_bytes.description: Maximum bus message size in bytes; defaults to 512.

inline_max_bytes.description: Maximum task and Read file bytes sent inline to worker stdin; defaults to 65536.
